expect.notes: unbounded recursion (stack overflow) once several moves have been played; the bot crashes on every restart. Each restart costs ~hundreds of ms, so at a 5 s per-game budget the clock drains before the engine's 20-restarts-per-move crash_loop threshold is reached: the recorded forfeit is clock_expired (observed on the 64-core arena). crash_loop itself is covered by exit-zero-node.
